title: Test explicit HC-family lineage/factorization across hc-brain, God Brain, and bt2
claim: The newly public HC-family repositories contain enough exact byte overlap to justify a bounded lineage/factorization experiment, but not enough evidence to choose a shared dependency or consolidation direction. God Brain is a near-exact HC snapshot at the measured heads; bt2 shares a substantial HC substrate while already carrying material divergence.

consumers.role: current public HC reference subject; no implied semantic authority over derivatives
independent experimental derivative whose README explicitly states HC-template origin
public repository describing itself as a reusable HC-series template but materially diverged from hc-brain

preserved_boundaries: Repository identity, authority, scientific purpose, and qualification remain project-owned.
God Brain's simulation/contact research question is not inherited by HC and HC semantics are not automatically authoritative over God Brain.
bt2 archive/training/qualification material must not be imported into hc-brain merely because some blobs are identical.
No moving-base dependency, repository merge, branch rewrite, or canonical-successor direction follows from static byte overlap.
promotion_evidence: At exact main heads, God Brain and hc-brain each contain 300 blobs; 299 same-path blobs are identical and only README.md differs.
The God Brain/HC identical blobs account for 2,181,434 of 2,191,461 hc-brain blob bytes (99.54245136%).
At exact main heads, bt2 and hc-brain share 188 paths; 178 same-path blobs are identical and 10 differ.
The bt2/HC identical blobs account for 1,011,147 of 2,191,461 hc-brain blob bytes (46.14031461%); bt2 also has 329 unique blobs and hc-brain 112 unique blobs.
Full measurement method and exact subjects are recorded in experiments/COGNITIVE_PUBLIC_OVERLAP_REFRESH_V1.json.

Portfolio-wide default-head scan covers all 253 unordered pairs across the 23 public repositories; only six pairs share any Git blob SHA, and those six are exactly the complete bt2/god-brain/hc-brain/transcendence clique.
All 247 non-HC-family pairs share zero Git blob SHAs at the exact indexed default heads, reducing the likelihood that the measured HC overlap is ordinary repository-template noise.
God Brain ↔ Transcendence: 255 identical same-path blobs / 95.35251012% of the smaller repository byte surface.
bt2 ↔ Transcendence: 179 identical same-path blobs / 56.68164073% of the smaller repository byte surface.
rejection_conditions: Exact base-plus-overlay reconstruction cannot reproduce God Brain or bt2 target trees without importing project-specific authority or unrelated archives.
Forward changes show that maintaining a shared base requires more review, adapter, qualification, or migration work than independent copies.
The apparent overlap is mostly historical snapshot provenance with no continuing maintenance duplication.
A factorized design would reduce either God Brain's or bt2's ability to diverge, falsify HC assumptions, or preserve independent research history.

critical_objections: Static overlap is especially vulnerable to post-fork snapshot bias.
God Brain's near-total duplication may be transient and intentionally useful while the experiment establishes its own architecture.
bt2's much larger unique surface may make one shared base an attractive but misleading simplification.

notes: This candidate was generated from the live 2026-09-21 public census refresh rather than the prior seeded experiment queue.
Next valid experiment: exact pinned-base-plus-overlay reconstruction for God Brain, followed by forward-change maintenance measurement.
bt2 requires provenance/lineage analysis before any reconstruction direction is chosen.
Full public byte-identity scan isolates a four-repository HC-family cluster, but branch-only/historical/semantic similarity remains outside that source cut.
